messages:
Avery: Opening a short Q&A thread from today's all-hands — asking for quick clarifications on API streaming, Console model billing UX, and Optimize feature rollout. Keep qs short.

Priya: Quick bullets: streaming alpha (low_latency) internal start May 3; Console per-model heatmap + CSV export beta by June 10; Optimize batching advisor MVP by July, quant advisor preview in August. I'll post a calendar + one-pager after this thread.

Jordan: For Console heatmap, will we show per-model-version latency over time (so customers can see regressions after a model swap)?

Priya: Yes — heatmap is per-model-version + per-route (chat/embeddings). We'll include a "version compare" mode and a CSV export for finance.

Marco: Engineering note: streaming low_latency needs an attention kernel + new scheduling. Canary plan: 2-week internal -> opt-in Dedicated customers -> progressive hosted rollout. If kernel lands late we'll slip by ~1 week.

Lina: Does low_latency mode change the API surface or require headers?

Sam: API change is minimal: new optional param streaming_mode: "low_latency". SDK helpers will default to safe behavior. We'll add an example and a reconnect/backpressure snippet in SDK 1.6.

Jordan: Will Dedicated customers be charged more if they opt into strict low-latency? need to be clear in comms.

Priya: No automatic charging. Console will show an "estimated infra delta" when toggling the mode; Dedicated customers may choose a recommended pool resize (we'll show the recommendation and the projected cost).

Lina: Optimize batching advisor question  will it run suggestions live against production traces or only on sampled jobs?

Marco: Initially on sampled/representative traces (customer opt-in). The advisor simulates batching impact and reports expected token cost savings and latency delta.

Sam: Quick curl example for the announcement FAQ:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Summarize the canary plan in 3 bullets."}'
```

OpsBot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-alpha (owner: Marco)

Avery: Action items recap: Priya will post timeline + one-pager today; Marco to publish canary checklist and perf metrics; Sam opens SDK PR with examples; Jordan drafts customer comms + FAQ; Lina to validate customer-facing wording. Please reply with a one-line ack when you start. Closing thread — will convert to a follow-up note. :wave:
